FDV ~$256,340; gateway stops 2025-03-10; 'community-run gateways will continue'

chain_status_evidence.summary: Migration to JEETS on Solana. Reasons: 'Network instability: Ongoing performance and reliability issues on the Vite native chain, including node and explorer disruptions. Security concerns: Increasing technical vulnerabilities and degraded trust in core infrastructure.' No specific hack/protocol bug named

'Due to instability issues on the VITE mainnet, which often cause network disruptions...' trading ceases; deposits closed; swap 100 VITE = 1 JEETS; 'Token to Rebrand as $JEETS... Following persistent problems on the VITE blockchain'
'Vite is dead. I wouldn't expect much. Money gone. My wallet says 15 cents now but there's nowhere to send it anyway because Vite is dead.'

JEETS x VITE airdrop snapshot-entry page. Hardcoded SNAPSHOT_TEXT = 'Snapshot (Vite Network): 11/11/25 00:00 (UTC)'. Page: 'Eligibility is based only on holding Jeets and VITE / VX (Vite chain) at the snapshot moment... No live checks here.' No live Vite RPC used; submits via Firebase Firestore (project jeets-ai)

'Jeets airdrop for vite holders' forwarding x.com/vitelabs/status/1974080261454536967; the tweet itself is now DELETED (syndication API returns TweetTombstone 'This Post was deleted by the Post author'; Wayback capture 2025-10-10 is a JS shell without text)

Declared Vite-network snapshot moment for the JEETS holder airdrop. Execution/claim evidence not publicly found; jeets.ai now has no DNS records (NXDOMAIN/NODATA); www CNAME jeets.ai; Wayback CDX shows /airdrop 301 (2025-09-28), /airdrop_vite 200 (2025-10-03), airdrop_ginux 301 (2025-10-01), claim.html (monthly game claim, 2025-09-10).
